name: NZBGet
description: NZBGet's source contains an RSA-SHA256 verification utility that hashes an input file, reads a signature record and PEM public key, and calls RSA_verify. Its maintenance update path separately reads an install script from package-info.json; this snapshot does not establish that the web installer path invokes the verifier, uses an embedded key, or obtains its manifest over HTTP.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the web UI's installer/manifest flow, embedded key material, transport URL, and call-site relationship to VerifySignature were not established.
